content.comment_body: I am trying to set up an MQTT connection from my [company_name] [product_name] (using [product_name] [version_no]) to a registered Zoho IoT device with valid credentials (username, password, and TLS settings). However, I keep running into a “Failed to parse” error when connecting to Zoho’s MQTT broker. Interestingly, the same configuration works fine when connecting to a local Mosquitto broker, confirming that the basic MQTT setup on the PLC side is correct. Given this, I’m not sure what specifically is preventing the connection to Zoho’s broker. Possible reasons could include: • Differences in MQTT protocol versions • TLS handshake or certificate authority mismatches • Authentication method discrepancies • DNS or hostname resolution issues within the PLC • Or, perhaps an MQTT bridge with Node-RED or similar is needed to act as an intermediary between the PLC and Zoho? I would appreciate any advice or troubleshooting steps to identify and resolve this issue.

This topic is closed because it is a duplicate and has been posted elsewhere. You can find the active discussion at: Issue Connecting [company_name] [product_name] to Zoho IoT via MQTT ([product_name] [version_no]) Kind regards, [user_name]
